title: Installation Jobs Service-Level Standards: Offer, Inspection and Punch Windows
content:
This branch service-level sheet sets the time standards, in business days, that apply to **Installation Jobs** under each installation method.

| Installation method | First crew date offered within (business days after the job is opened) | New crew date offered within (business days after a reschedule) | Final inspection booked within (business days after completion, permitted jobs) | Every punch item resolved within (business days after completion) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Insert Pocket Installation | 10 | 10 | 0 | 10 |
| Full-Frame Installation | 10 | 10 | 5 | 10 |
| Full-Frame Installation with Exterior Trim Wrap | 10 | 10 | 5 | 10 |
| Masonry Opening Installation | 12 | 12 | 5 | 12 |
| Bay and Bow Installation | 15 | 15 | 10 | 12 |
| Door System Installation | 10 | 10 | 5 | 10 |

## Notes to the sheet

- A figure of 0 in the final inspection column means the method carries no final inspection window.
- The first-offer column and the reschedule-offer column carry the same figure for every method; they are nevertheless two separate standards, one running from the opening of the job and the other from a reschedule.
- The punch item column applies to every job; the final inspection column applies to permitted jobs.

## Reading the sheet (hypothetical examples)

- A hypothetical Bay and Bow Installation job is offered its first crew date within 15 business days, and its punch items are resolved within 12 business days of completion.
- A hypothetical permitted Full-Frame Installation job has its final inspection booked within 5 business days of completion and its punch items resolved within 10 business days.
